## Cursor Setup

Cursor reads project rules from `.cursor/rules/`. To keep the Astryx context in a rule of its own, write it there. Give a path relative to the project root, such as `.cursor/rules/astryx.mdc`; an absolute path is refused.

Install as a Cursor project rule:
```bash
npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 init --features agents --agent-docs-path .cursor/rules/astryx.mdc
```

Rerunning the same command rewrites only the Astryx block, so frontmatter you add above it (such as `alwaysApply: true`) stays.
